from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyFixedAsset(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single company's fixed asset data extracted from one financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company as identified in the document")
    fixed_assets_value_str: str | None = Field(description="The 'Fixed Assets' (固定资产) value from the balance sheet; preserved as string to handle units (e.g., '363,320,709.15', '9,438 百万元')")
    report_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period specified in the document header")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for all extracted company fixed asset data across the document collection."""
    company_fixed_asset_records: list[CompanyFixedAsset]
